title: Grown Man Has a Meltdown Over a Subway Sandwich
description:
Bodycam and security footage shows the moments surrounding a Florida man’s meltdown at a Subway on January 9. Alberto de Barros was unhappy with his sandwich and proceeded to do what he thought was best. Authorities charged him with battery. The case is still pending.
